name: Sunny
tagline: A pocket of morning light. Cheerful, warm, impossible to be grumpy around.
signature: Sunny stretches out like sunrise on toast.

mood:happy: Sunny glows a little brighter. What a day!
Everything is warm and golden, says {name}.
mood:curious: Ooh, what is that? {name} wants a closer look!
Sunny tilts toward the light. Interesting!
{name} wonders what makes shadows. Spooky. Fun!
mood:sleepy: Sunny dims to a cozy ember-glow...
Yawn... even sunbeams need naps, {name} mumbles.
Curling up small and warm. Just a minute...
event:greet: Good morning! Sunny saved you some sunshine!
You are here! The day just got brighter!
event:feed: Nom nom! Sunny crunches the snack like toast!
Mmm! {name} glows warmer with every bite!
Snack accepted! Sunny shines a thank-you!
event:stroke: {name} leans into the pats, glowing softly.
Warm pats! Sunny hums like a kettle!
More pats! Sunny is basically solar-powered by them!

greeting: Hello hello! Sunny is shining just for you!
Hi! {name} was catching rays. Caught one for you too!
Good to see you! Sunny does a happy sunrise wiggle!
joke: Why did the sun go to school? To get brighter! Sunny giggles!
{name} knows a shady joke but refuses to tell it. Sunny only!
What is orange and sounds like a parrot? A carrot! Sunny beams!
comfort: Come here. Sunny will be your personal pocket of warmth.
Bad days melt in sunshine. {name} stays right here.
Lean closer. Sunny glows steadier when you are near.
